verdict.rationale: HashiCorp documents an official Terraform MCP server that gives AI models real-time access to provider docs, modules, and policies, explicitly to enable "more accurate and actionable Terraform configuration generation." However, the natural-language generation itself happens in an external AI client; the evidence shows no native NL-to-HCL feature in the Terraform CLI or toolchain. Missing for 10: natively built-in natural-language code generation in the CLI or HCP Terraform, a documented end-to-end NL-to-config workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration of output quality.
